qa_pair.question: Confirm that the local HeliosGen server is reachable, inspect every built-in text provider, and exclude the automatic Azure router. How many explicitly selectable text models remain? Answer with one integer.
After checking server status and the complete text-model registry, identify the exact model ID marked as Anthropic's flagship in this build. Answer with the ID only.
Inspect the full text registry and distinguish OpenAI's Responses transport from its legacy chat-completions transport. How many OpenAI models use Responses? Answer with one integer.
Compare the built-in image and video registries, then find the image model accepting the greatest number of reference images. What is its human-readable name?

Inspect all built-in video models. Among models that generate sound and accept at least ten reference videos, which one also accepts both explicit start and end frames? Answer with its human-readable name.
Compare every built-in video provider and find the sound-disabled model whose default resolution is 2K and whose maximum duration is fifteen seconds. Answer with its human-readable name.
Confirm the community catalog is available, compare every entry's byte size and node count, and identify the smallest workflow. Answer with its displayed name.
Inspect the complete community catalog and compare all node counts. Which workflow has the most nodes? Answer with its displayed name.
Browse the complete community catalog, compare the authors, and identify the only workflow not authored by @ReflctWillie. Answer with its displayed name.
Search the community catalog for workflows tagged with more than one provider, then compare their download sizes. Which is smaller? Answer with its displayed name.
